summary: Loads and rebuilds the track scene/terrain. Builds a weather-dependent path buffer (allocated, '.hat' + track basename + '^' separator, '.scn' handling), queries registry timestamps to detect a newer source, and when newer or when the weather-mode flag is set loads the terrain via HTreeTerrainFileFormatLoader, ensures the directory hierarchy exists via CreateDirectoryAWrapper, and rebuilds collision geometry (CollisionShapeInit, CollisionGeometryOperationSelector, BoundingBoxComputationFromTriangles, sub_44BC50, PhysicsBufferFree, CollisionGridRaycast32x32). Frees the temporary path buffer on exit. Gated by EmptyStubWithFlagCheck debug/profile stubs when dword_8B8F24 is non-zero.

local_names.v3: track path pointer from dword_7CE5D0 with byte_5EA438 fallback
local_names.v15: offset from '.scn' position to dword_5C448C source string

operations.description: Entry debug/profile gate: if dword_8B8F24 is non-zero, call EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(2, 0).
CollisionTreeNodeCleanup(this) clears the existing collision tree state before rebuilding.
SinTableInit() initializes sine tables.
Take the track path from dword_7CE5D0 (fallback byte_5EA438) and walk back to the last backslash (decimal 92) to isolate the file basename into v4.
v26 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(256); *v26 = 0 allocates the temporary path buffer.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(dword_5EC438 or byte_5EA438) copies the weather/season directory path into the v26 buffer.
sub_5665B0(aHat) appends the '.hat' extension and sub_5665B0(v4) appends the track basename.
Strip the extension: locate the period (decimal 46) in the built path and null-terminate there.
sub_5665B0(aHat_0) appends the '^' separator field during path building.
If byte_7CFEE8 (weather-mode flag) is set, skip the registry timestamp checks entirely and continue to the load path.
RegistryKeyQuery on the built path and on dword_7CE5D0 (fallback byte_5EA438); if the source timestamp is not newer (query >= saved value v9), skip the rebuild.
strcpy SrcStr from the track path, sub_589901(SrcStr) normalizes it, then sub_587C20(SrcStr, aScn_0) locates the '.scn' substring.
If the '.scn' substring is not found (v13 null), skip the rebuild path.
Copy the dword_5C448C string byte-by-byte to the destination offset v15 = v13 - &dword_5C448C, extending the scene path with the weather-dependent string identifier.
If RegistryKeyQuery(SrcStr) >= v11 skip; fill v30 via sub_4CEEF0(v30, 256); if RegistryKeyQuery(v30) >= v11 skip.
If HTreeTerrainFileFormatLoader(this, v26 path) succeeds, continue with the collision rebuild; otherwise fall to the cleanup path.
On the successful load path CollisionTreeNodeCleanup(this) is called again before rebuilding geometry.
Shared cleanup path: StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v26) reinitializes the path buffer.

Walk byte_5EA438 path segments; at each backslash segment call sub_587DD0(PathName, byte_5EA438, v21), null-terminate, and CreateDirectoryAWrapper(PathName); finally CreateDirectoryAWrapper(byte_5EA438) creates the full directory hierarchy.
CollisionShapeInit(v28) initializes the collision shape/work structure.
CollisionGeometryOperationSelector(this, a2, v28) selects the geometry operation to run on the loaded data.
BoundingBoxComputationFromTriangles(this, v28) computes bounding boxes from the collision triangles.
sub_44BC50(this, v26 path, v28) builds the collision structures, then PhysicsBufferFree(v28) releases the work buffer.
CollisionGridRaycast32x32(this) performs a 32x32 grid raycast setup over the rebuilt collision geometry.
Exit debug/profile gate: if dword_8B8F24 is non-zero, call EmptyStubWithFlagCheck(1, 0).
Return the temporary v26 path buffer, freeing it with FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null.
